Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) on **your own browser**: a local WebSocket bridge plus

a
Chrome/Edge MV3 extension expose `browser_*` tools to the model, with a configurable URL policy i

n front.
AGPL-3.0-only.

## Security model
- **The real boundary is the loopback address plus the token** in the profile config. The agent can

read and
rewrite that config, so the token separates you from other local processes — not from the a

gent.
- **URL policy** — per-realm `allow` / `ask` / `deny` (internet, LAN, loopback), allow and den

y host lists,
cloud-metadata blocking, and an approval prompt for unknown hosts.
- **`readOnly` / `a

llowScript`** — refused commands never reach the browser, so they leave no side effects.
- **Extensi

on-side hard lock** — the popup's 「锁定」 freezes every browser command; only the popup can undo it.
-

**Take-over overlay** — `browser_hold` dims the page and shows what the model is doing; the user
dou
ble-clicks to take the page back, after which the model's click / input / press / nav on that tab ar

e
refused until it turns the overlay off.

never runs a browser.
